note: 11 Nov 2026 - 'The Secrets of Happiness & Joy | The Kevin Trudeau Show | Ep. 13' (Rumble v4vdcy0). Weekly agent. Only 3 clips: this episode is mostly oneness/manifesting-adjacent spiritual teaching (God, gurus, chakras) and a long Global Information Network/cruise sales pitch - both skip territory. Mined the three Kevin-solo stretches that are a real story with a concrete number or lesson rather than a spiritual argument.

clips.send: A guy who just got his first raise sends this to a friend who says tithing is pointless - awe that the richest man ever gave first, not last.
clips.caption:
J.D. Rockefeller died the richest man in modern history - in today's money, over $650 billion, most of it in cash.

Kevin Trudeau points out what people skip: Rockefeller gave away 10% of his income before he kept a cent, starting back when he was earning almost nothing.

He didn't wait until he was rich to start giving. He gave first, every single paycheck, long before there was any fortune to speak of.

Most people plan to give once they've "made it." Rockefeller made it giving first.

Where does giving fit in your plan: first, or "once I can afford it"?

#kevintrudeau #rockefeller #wealthmindset #richhabits #moneymindset #financialfreedom

clips.send: A guy stuck in a job he hates sends this to a friend blaming their mood on their circumstances - awe that a man ten years into a prison sentence chose happy anyway.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau spent eight and a half years in federal prison. One day, walking the yard, the warden stopped him.

The warden told him he'd run that prison for 35 years and seen tens of thousands of inmates - and never once seen a man who was actually happy to be there.

Kevin's answer: "I'm here. I have a choice. I can either be happy or miserable. I choose to be happy. Because if I'm miserable, I'm still here."

Nothing about his situation changed in that moment. Only the choice did.

What's the one thing you're waiting to be different before you let yourself be happy?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #resilience #richhabits #wealthmindset #motivation

clips.send: A minimalist sends this to a friend who can't throw anything away - the queasy recognition of hoarding your own worthless bottle caps too.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau brings up the show Hoarders to make a point about money and happiness.

A producer tries to get one man to throw away the least valuable thing in his house - a little jar of old, rusted bottle caps. Worth nothing. Not a single dollar for the whole jar.

The man has a panic attack at the idea of losing them. He'd put his essence into objects that were worth zero.

Kevin's point: attachment to stuff, any stuff, works the same way whether it's bottle caps or a mansion full of things you don't use.

What's your version of the bottle caps?
